episodes.name: The Client
episodes.overview: Will revels in Ashley's music industry success, but both Will and Ashley are about to have a rude surprise.

episodes.name: What's Will Got to Do With It?
episodes.overview: Will helps Ashley make a big impression on a recording executive, but Philip is adamantly against her pursuing a singing career.

episodes.name: Reality Bites
episodes.overview: Will loses points as a role model for Nicky while visiting an ever-positive kiddie hero who brings joy to youngsters - but not to Will.

episodes.name: Grumpy Young Men
episodes.overview: War breaks out when the girl Will likes plants a big one on Carlton.

episodes.name: Fresh Prince: The Movie
episodes.overview: Will tells a tall tale about seeing a mob killing, then being placed in a witness-protection program in the backwoods of Alabama.

episodes.name: Will's Misery
episodes.overview: The Banks hate the ugly golf shirts Hilary gives them - until they see Kareem Abdul-Jabbar wearing the same design.

episodes.name: Father Knows Best
episodes.overview: To help Ashley out of a jam at school, Will poses as her father. Oh yeah, this is gonna work.

episodes.name: Soooooooul Train
episodes.overview: At a Soul Train reunion, middle-aged Philip feels like his train has left the station.

episodes.name: Love Hurts
episodes.overview: Lisa humiliates Will by knocking out a guy with her self-defense moves.

episodes.name: Will's Up a Dirt Road
episodes.overview: Will tries his hand at journalism to prove something to Lisa, but his efforts get him sued for libel - by Jay Leno.

episodes.name: Will Steps Out
episodes.overview: To understand Philip's battle with the scale, Will dons a fat suit and gets a big fat lesson in empathy.

episodes.name: Same Game, Next Season
episodes.overview: Will works so hard to impress Lisa's dad that he spends all his free time with his new best buddy.

episodes.name: Three's a Crowd
episodes.overview: Will gets roped into a weekend ski trip with Carlton that quickly turns to disaster when their party arrives; meanwhile, back home, Hilary prepares to leave the nest.

episodes.name: It's a Wonderful Lie
episodes.overview: The party's over. Will and Lisa tell each other lies so they can sneak off to the (uh-oh) same party.

episodes.name: Bullets Over Bel-Air
episodes.overview: A planned camping trip is cut short for Carlton and Will when a robber approaches them at an automated bank-teller machine - and fires a gun.

episodes.name: A Decent Proposal
episodes.overview: Mr. and Mrs. Smith? Will pops the question from his hospital room. And Lisa's answer is...

episodes.name: Will is from Mars...
episodes.overview: Thanks to relationship counseling, Will and Lisa hop to move on up to a new understanding in preparation for marriage. Meanwhile Hillary wants Geoffrey to work at her new home.

episodes.name: The Wedding Show (Psyche!)
episodes.overview: Shafted! The engaged couple opts for flashy Vegas vows, complete with costumes. The tasteful theme: Shaft.

episodes.name: Slum Like It... Not!
episodes.overview: Will vows Philip with his sound investment advice to buy Jazz's apartment building - but the tenants scream slumlord after Philip acts on Will's moneymaking tip.

episodes.name: As the Will Turns
episodes.overview: Will inadvertently finds himself in the right place at the right time and lands a part in a daytime soap opera.

episodes.name: Save the Last Trance for Me
episodes.overview: Put into a trance by a stage hypnotist, Will behaves like a 4-year-old just as the family gears up for an interview with the admissions head of a private school.

episodes.name: To Thine Own Self Be Blue... and Gold
episodes.overview: A dream job for Will with a businessman friend of Philip's turns into a nightmare when the man offers him a bonus to help bribe a councilman.

episodes.name: Cold Feet, Hot Body
episodes.overview: Dinner date. The Banks host a gorgeous girl from Philly who tries to lure Will away from Lisa.

episodes.name: Love in an Elevator
episodes.overview: Stuck and out of luck, Will spends his bachelor party trapped in an elevator with a feuding Carlton and Jazz.

episodes.name: For Whom the Wedding Bells Toll
episodes.overview: Husband-to-be Will has the bride, the ring, the date...and second thoughts about the whole idea.
